proposals.evidence: These nominal answers to hungry prompts are the hunger noun, compared with Turner bubhukṣā: regional bukha/bhukkh, Nepali bhok and Assamese bhok. They are kept distinct from the overt -ā/-o hungry adjectives. This analysis covers the actual elicited form, without adding an unspoken copula.
